scroll-area.$description: ScrollArea scrollbar. Component tokens reference semantic tokens; a literal here is a decision this component owns, and the description is why.

thumb.$description: Resting thumb: a translucent graphite tint of the text colour, so one value reads on every surface a scroll area lives on — canvas, card, sunken log well, menu, nested panel — in both themes. Quiet at rest (about 2:1); clipped content already signals that the region scrolls.

thumb-hover.$description: Thumb while the pointer is over the scroll area or the user is scrolling — the moment its position is being read — at 3:1 or better against every surface in both themes.

thumb-active.$description: Thumb under the pointer or being dragged: the direct-manipulation state, one clear step above hover.

size.$description: Scrollbar thickness, padding included (the thumb is 6px inside a 2px gutter). Fixed rather than density-scaled: it is a pointer target, and compact density must not make it harder to grab.
